answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the lotus of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. A jade of per-task receipts records who did what, and the summit of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on time-locked work history, split across independent auditors, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks.
